title: cynanchum macrophyllum var. nikoense
intro: Cynanchum macrophyllum var. nikoense, commonly known as Japanese Hound's Tongue, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Japanese Hound's Tongue are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
